RFC9072-2-1.note: Re-judged 2026-10-21 by an independent judge (spec-bgp-open-session-rfc-defects AC-4), against rfc/full/rfc9072.txt Section 2: 'if the length of the Optional Parameters in the BGP OPEN message does exceed 255, the OPEN message MUST be encoded according to the procedure below', the procedure being Non-Ext OP Len 255, Non-Ext OP Type 255, the two-octet Extended Opt. Parm. Length, and 'the Parameter Length field is extended to be a two-octet unsigned integer'. Carrier: reactor TestRFC9072OptionalParamsBoundary drives Session.buildOpen -> capability.PackOptionalParams -> Open.WriteTo at capability totals 0, 2, 253, 254, 255, 256, 300 and asserts every octet of the procedure at 254 and above (both markers, Extended Opt. Parm. Length 3+capTotal, Parm. Type 2, two-octet Parameter Length capTotal, body 16+capTotal), the RFC 4271 form at 253 and below, and a conforming decode. Judge overlay mutants of PackOptionalParams, tracked file untouched, all red against a green HEAD: the D1 threshold (valueTotal <= 255) fails 'capTotal 254: Extended Opt. Parm. Length' (expected 257, actual 256); a threshold one low (baseOctets < 255) fails 'capTotal 253: Parm. Type'. message TestOpenPackExtendedParams adds the positive envelope at 300 octets. Finding: TestTheExtendedEnvelopeAndItsParametersAgree is weak for its negative claim 'the extended envelope is never written around parameters that are not in the extended framing': its input is already in the two-octet framing, WriteTo copies the parameter bytes and UnpackOpen returns them opaque, so the same body passes with one-octet-framed parameters; it carries no discrimination record. The requirement's verdict rests on the boundary unit, whose both polarities hold.

RFC9072-2-2.note: TestRFC9072ShortExtendedOpenIsAccepted: an extended OPEN with 9 parameter octets decodes with no error, ExtendedParams true, parameters exact, ASN4 4200000001 parsed; a classic reading of the same octets does not recover it; the classic OPEN of the same capability decodes ExtendedParams false to the same capability.

RFC9072-2-3.note: {single-polarity: positive} on the row. TestOpenPackExtendedParams requires body[9]==0xFF and now the exact body length; writeToExtended writes the constant.

RFC9072-2-4.note: {single-polarity: positive} on the row. TestOpenPackExtendedParams requires body[10]==0xFF; writeToExtended writes the constant.

RFC9072-3-2.note: Re-judged 2026-10-14 (independent auditor). Unit changed only by the move to the one packer (capability.PackOptionalParams via packPeerOptionalParams). TestRFC9072ParameterType255OnlyAsTheExtendedMarker fills capability values with 0xFF octets, writes the OPEN and walks the framing the OPEN announces: below 256 octets no envelope and types [2]; above, the 255/255 envelope and every parameter type 2, framing ending exactly at the OPEN's end. TestOpenPackExtendedParams carries the positive marker position. A packer emitting 255 as a parameter type, or the marker on a short OPEN, goes red.
